entry: reactive.ts[DD9L]: F:创建并缓存响应式代理，按可变或只读与深浅形态分派到两套陷阱 | R:code:packages/reactivity/src/baseHandlers.ts,code:packages/reactivity/src/collectionHandlers.ts,code:packages/reactivity/src/constants.ts | A:reactive,readonly,toRaw,isReactive | S:对已是代理的对象原样返回，唯 readonly 包 reactive 时例外；四种形态各用一张 WeakMap，合并会让不同代理互相覆盖
